prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: exact 1536x1024 six-frame desktop-pet sheet, 3 columns x 2 rows, 512x512 per cell. Input is the EDIT TARGET, not loose inspiration. Keep exact native anime linework, same head/face shape, blue eye shape and size, same slim body proportions, blue bob hair/cowlick, white blouse, three blue-yellow-blue bows, gray pleated skirt, navy socks, brown shoes. Do not redraw as a rounder chibi. Do not scale, move, enlarge, or zoom any figure. Feet, head size and centerline stay at original pixel coordinates. Keep six figures in the exact original locations. Background is intentional perfectly FLAT SOLID #00FF00 chroma green to be removed using authorized local processing. Preserve background green in all holes too, no shadows, gradients, checkerboard, noise, texture, floor, labels or gridlines. No green reflected on the character. Change only tiny eyelid details, shoulder and hair-tip breathing. Six restrained consecutive quiet idle poses: 1 original calm open eyes; 2 barely perceptible inhale, eyes open; 3 softly HALF-lowered eyelids, pupils STILL visible, NOT closed eyes; 4 eyes back fully open, slight release; 5 nearly original pose with a tiny hair-tip settle; 6 exact calm pose very close to frame1. Both arms stay relaxed at the original sides, no props. Keep mouth a tiny closed soft smile throughout, no winking, no closed eye arc, no big expression changes. The host holds each pose for about0.7 to1.9 seconds, so this must look quietly alive, never a frozen blink. Maximum movement 2 native pixels (4 source pixels), shoes fixed. Make minimally localized edits, preserve the original drawing and face.
